teleportCountdownTicks: How many ticks should pass before teleporting the player, starting from when the teleportation is triggerred.
teleportCooldownTicks: How many ticks should pass before the player can trigger a teleport again, starting from when the player is last teleported.
cancelTeleportOnMove: Whether the player can move about when waiting for the teleport countdown.
cancelTeleportOnHurt: Whether the teleportation should be cancelled if the player is hurt by any source during the teleport countdown.
cancelTeleportOnPlayerHurt: Whether the teleportation should be cancelled if the player is hurt by another player during the teleport countdown. Overridden if cancelTeleportOnHurt is set to true.
cancelTeleportOnChatMessage: Whether the teleportation should be cancelled if the player sends any chat messages.
startTeleportWhileMoving: Whether the teleportation should be triggered if the player is moving (flying, falling, walking, etc).
enablePhomes: Whether public homes should be created or teleported to.
phomeLimit: How many public homes can be collectively created. Has priority over phomeLimitPerPlayer, set to 0 for no limit
phomeLimitPerPlayer: How many public homes can be created per player. Set to 0 for no limit.
modifyOtherPhomes: Whether players can edit (rename, change location of, etc) public homes that are not created by them.
viewPhomeLocation: Whether players can view locations of public homes directly without teleporting to them
enableHomes: Whether private homes should be created or teleported to.
homeLimit: How many private homes can be created per player. Set to 0 for no limit.
teleportFacing: Whether the players angle should be changed when they teleport to a specific location.
takeEnderPearlDamage: Whether the player should take the default ender pearl damage when they teleport.
useDialogs: Whether to prioritize using dialogs to display any menus. When disabled, chat and inbluit GUI (e.g. chests) will be used instead. Suitable for servers that backport to before 1.21.6.
enableTpa: Whether the player should be able to teleport to other players/allow other players to teleport to them.
